description: Reusable credential/connection to an external service (Azure SQL, ADLS, Snowflake, Event Hubs, etc.). Tenant-scoped — shared across workspaces. Required by items that access external data (including Eventstream sources).

flags.--connection-type: Connection type (connectionDetails.type), e.g. SQL, EventHub, Oracle, MQTT, ConfluentCloud, Web. Discover via list-supported-types.
flags.--creation-method: connectionDetails.creationMethod. OPTIONAL: when omitted, fabio auto-resolves it from the connection type via supportedConnectionTypes (most types differ, e.g. SQL->Sql, EventHub->EventHub.Contents). Specify explicitly only for the few types with multiple methods (AzureDataExplorer, Spark).
flags.--parameters: Connection parameters as a JSON object (converted to the API array form). Required param names vary by type (e.g. EventHub needs endpoint + entityPath).
flags.--credential-type: Basic | OAuth2 | Key | Anonymous | ServicePrincipal | SharedAccessSignature | WorkspaceIdentity | KeyPair
flags.--credentials: Credential fields as JSON (shape depends on credential type)
flags.--gateway-id: Required when connectivity type is VirtualNetworkGateway or StreamingVirtualNetworkGateway
flags.--skip-test-connection: Skip the connection test during creation (not supported by all type/connectivity combinations)
flags.--allow-code-first-artifacts: Set allowUsageInUserControlledCode=true so code-first artifacts (Notebooks) can use this connection. CREATE-TIME ONLY — cannot be changed later (alias --allow-usage-in-user-controlled-code).
flags.--allow-gateway-usage: Set allowConnectionUsageInGateway=true so the connection can be used with on-premises / VNet data gateways.

notes: Tenant-level scope: endpoints at /connections/{id} (NO workspace prefix)
Connectivity types: ShareableCloud, OnPremises, VirtualNetworkGateway, StreamingVirtualNetworkGateway, PersonalCloud
Credential types: Basic, OAuth2, Key, Anonymous, ServicePrincipal, SharedAccessSignature, WorkspaceIdentity, KeyPair
Privacy levels: None, Public, Organizational, Private
Parameters provided as a JSON object are converted to the API array format automatically

creationMethod usually differs from the connection type (SQL->Sql, EventHub->EventHub.Contents, ConfluentCloud->ConfluentCloud.Contents, MQTT->MQTT.Contents; only ~12 of ~276 types match the type name). fabio auto-resolves it from supportedConnectionTypes when --creation-method is omitted, so create just works. Only types with MULTIPLE creation methods (AzureDataExplorer, Spark) require --creation-method; fabio errors and enumerates the valid values for those.
VirtualNetworkGateway and StreamingVirtualNetworkGateway connections require --gateway-id (the gateway's object ID)

Azure Event Hubs connections support the WorkspaceIdentity credential type: create with --connection-type EventHub --creation-method EventHub.Contents --credential-type WorkspaceIdentity (params: endpoint, entityPath). This is the connection an Eventstream 'AzureEventHub' extended-features source references for Workspace Identity authentication (no shared access key).

list-supported-types -o json returns each type's creationMethods (with required parameters) and supportedCredentialTypes — the source of truth for --creation-method, --parameters, and --credential-type

allowUsageInUserControlledCode (--allow-code-first-artifacts) is the 'Allow Code-First Artifacts like Notebooks to access this connection' toggle. It can ONLY be set at creation time and is not modifiable afterward; the created connection reflects it in show/list output.
